evidence.title: 🤯 Free Public APIs API - Tested Every Single Day.

name: Free Public APIs
summary: Directory of 755 free public APIs, each endpoint tested daily and scored on reliability, error rate and response time.
description: A curated, health-checked collection of free public APIs for students and developers: every endpoint is called once every 24 hours and scored 0-100, so failing APIs rank low and are eventually removed. Browsable with tags (best, newest, popular, fastest, no errors, reliable, showcase) and queryable through the site's own free API.
